items.title: F3 Lightning: How Meta Accelerates Ads ML Features to Production at Scale
items.summary: Facebook Feature Framework (F3) is Meta’s framework for authoring, compiling, and serving the machine learning features underlying ads ranking models, where a single request can require more than 20,000 features. We first presented F3 at AI @ Scale 2020.  F3 reduced execution computational costs by compiling all features into a single merged graph, but that [...]Read More...The post F3 Lightning: How Meta Accelerates Ads ML Features to Production at Scale appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
